description: Call a hosted mock route or mutate its CRUD records. Uses the same caller access, limits and revision checks as HTTP. Management tokens do not grant caller access. Owned OAuth providers also accept protocol paths, form fields in body and a userinfo bearer accessToken; authorization redirects include location.

accessToken.description: Private caller access token, supplied separately from the URL.

path.description: Relative collection or route path, optionally with query parameters.

name: call_mock_api
